full_judgment: 17. The next decision cited by the learned Advocate is reported in 12 DLR page 90. In this case a re-trial was directed on the ground that the trial was vitiated by misjoinder of charges. So this decision supported a case of re-trial instead of a case for discharge of accused without any re-trial.
